Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: cousined1
Message:
fix: pre-audit remediation pass (billing sync, tenant isolation, ingest columns, chat guards)

Preserves the uncommitted working tree found at audit start:
- billing: webhook watermark ties can no longer resurrect a canceled
  subscription; plan-change sync result surfaced to client
- pricing: single resolvePriceId for env/VITE_ price ids; trial-eligible
  plans single-sourced from server-billing.cjs (monthly only)
- tenant: facility emissions resolves caller company first (removes
  cross-tenant id oracle); compliance signoff persists and is scoped
- ingest: co2e_kg/activity_date/notes persisted; import vs activity dates
- reliability: guarded async handlers, health endpoint try/catch,
  ROLLBACK guard, chat bot error fallback, lead-save failure surfaced
- factors: emission-factors.json expanded + verification notes
- frontend: stripe.ts runtime pk resolution, price cache failure not
  promoted, page fixes (verified green: lint, tsc, 204 tests, build)
